propositions: outbound_links.py imports adapters.jira vendor translation code directly, violating core abstraction boundaries and ADR 0035 canonical shape principle
link type diffing compares vendor-specific Jira shape (issuelinks with type/inwardIssue/outwardIssue) instead of canonical relation vocabulary in core
SupportsLinks port capability must provide map_remote_links to translate remote vendor links to canonical entries and link_payload_for_relation to emit vendor types for payloads
core link diffing must become backend-neutral by moving both vendor→canonical and canonical→vendor translations onto the adapter's SupportsLinks implementation
direction-agnostic ADD dedup must be preserved: a local dep deduplicates against remote links of the same vendor type and target key regardless of link direction
